listing.name: God of War: Ascension — Ascension (arnaldolima1) (arnaldolima1)
listing.summary: The project reports the first level and boss at about 18–23 FPS and 13–21 FPS on one machine. The game cannot currently be completed. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Europe BCES01741 version 1.00 disc, decrypted EBOOT.ELF and required system files.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the source-build instructions with VS2022 Clang/MSVC, CMake, Ninja and the Vulkan SDK. The project estimates 20–40 minutes to compile. This guide does not identify a player release.

warnings: The project reports the first level and boss at about 18–23 FPS and 13–21 FPS on one machine. The game cannot currently be completed.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
